description:
Tucked into the hills where Calabasas meets Topanga Canyon in the Highlands, this inviting home offers a rare blend of privacy, natural beauty, and effortless indoor-outdoor living—reminiscent of the charm and creative spirit of Laurel Canyon. Wake up to sweeping mountain views from nearly every room, where sunlight filters through the canyon and the pace of life slows just enough to breathe. The home features three bedrooms, two bathrooms, and an additional living space, thoughtfully designed to feel both comfortable and connected to its surroundings. At the heart of the home, recently added bifold doors open wide to a refreshed deck, creating a seamless flow between the interior living spaces and the outdoors—perfect for morning coffee, evening gatherings, or simply taking in the quiet beauty of the hills. The deck is also equipped with electrical outlets for future customization.
Beyond the main home, a detached approximately 100 sq. ft. flex space with its own mini-split A/C offers endless versatility—ideal for a private office, creative studio, fitness room, or guest retreat. Two additional storage sheds provide practical convenience, while dual driveways offer ample parking for up to five vehicles. An exterior outlet at the front of the home is ready for EV charging. Life here is defined by connection to nature. Step outside to nearby hiking trails, enjoy the peaceful surroundings, and experience the charm of local wildlife. The neighborhood also features Calabasas Highlands Park, offering a playground, picnic area, and space for dogs. Despite its tranquil setting, the home is just minutes from everyday conveniences and some of the area’s most sought-after destinations, including The Commons at Calabasas, Old Town Calabasas, Viewpoint School, and Malibu Creek State Park, with Malibu’s iconic beaches just a short drive away. Located within the highly regarded Las Virgenes Unified School District. Additional highlights include a new tankless water heater (2026), updated fencing and decking, and newer major appliances—including a gas range/oven, microwave, refrigerator, washer, and dryer—all purchased within the past three years. The property is also zoned for horses, adding flexibility and long-term value. An enclosed catio is also included. More than just a home—it’s a lifestyle rooted in nature, privacy, and the unique character of the Calabasas Highlands.
